messages:
Maya: Heads up — tungsten-22k-int3 onboarding failing long-prefix stress. Repro on ~20k tokens shows KV cache divergence.
Carlos: ugh. logs?
Maya: repro command and quick log snippet:
```
./run_onboard.sh --model tungsten-22k-int3 --quant int3 --ctx 20000 --prompt-file tests/long_prefix/20k.txt --seed 42
```
Maya: server tail: `kv_index_mismatch at layer 23: expected 0x1f4b got 0x1f3b`
Erin: is this before or after rotary refactor? :thinking: 
Maya: after — bisect points to rot-refactor commit 5f8a2a (runtime).
Carlos: hmm could be RoPE scale calculation in the int path. saw something vaguely similar on atlas onboarding.
Maya: hypothesis: scale rounding in quantized path causes phase offsets that accumulate over long prefixes -> KV keys shift.
Erin: can you try forcing float32 rotary table as a quick check?
Maya: quick patch applied to force float32 for rotary_table_dtype, rebuilt kernels, re-ran: divergence disappears but perf down ~8%.
ci-bot: nightly-job tungsten-22k-int3-longprefix #1987 failed — https://ci.redwood-infra/jobs/1987
Carlos: try my bisect helper: `tools/kv-bisect.sh --job 1987 --range HEAD~50..HEAD`
Maya: ran bisect. culprit narrowed to runtime PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/912 (rotary refactor).
Erin: skimmed the PR — I see an int->uint truncation in the kernel where freq_index = floor(freq * scale) instead of round().
Maya: exact. changing to round (lrintf) in the kernel stops the drift in local 20k runs.
Carlos: sweet. is there a unit test we can add to catch accumulation over long context? maybe synthetic fingerprints every 1k tokens.
Maya: adding a longprefill-fingerprint test that asserts identical KV hashes after prefill+replay. patch in branch.
Erin: open a runtime PR with kernel fix + test and tag eng-ml + eng-runtime reviewers.
Maya: opened PR #923 (includes lrintf fix and longprefill-fingerprint test). kicking off full harness overnight. :100:
ci-bot: triggered job tungsten-22k-int3-longprefix #1988 for PR #923
sre-bot: created incident placeholder INC-2026 for failing nightly and linked PR #923
Maya: will follow up tomorrow with harness results. thanks all. :pray:
